IncidentBot: ALERT: paging.latency.p99 crossed threshold (2.9s) in prod-us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T02:14:27Z. Auto-escalation to #incidents.
Amanda (oncall): taking this. p95/p99 are spiking and we're seeing streaming stalls reported by the runtime. pulling graphs now.
Kai W.: grafana link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/boards/latency?panel=pageflow - p95 jumped 380ms -> 1.6s around 02:14, p99 ~2.9s. streaming.stalls/sec up x8.
SRE Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-5791. Paging tier experiencing elevated eviction / low cache hit rates.
Mike L.: quick context: about 02:12 we deployed prefix-hash v2 (rollout to 30% traffic) and also ran an invalidation cron that clears stale prefetch keys for the new namespace.
Jessica R.: hit-rate metric: prefixcache_hit_rate.prod-us-west-2 dropped from 87% to 11% starting 02:14. Confirmed many misses and subsequent paging/backfill.
Amanda (oncall): ok, likely correlation. Are misses causing synchronous disk/page reads? need to know if it's prefetch warmup or eviction wave.
Kai W.: logs from pfxcache: ```[02:14:19] WARN prefix_lookup miss key=usr/sha256:ab12.. count=1
[02:14:20] WARN prefix_lookup miss key=usr/sha256:cd34.. count=1
[02:14:21] INFO paging.fetch backfill_id=pf-876 status=miss io_ms=4200``` lots of backfills hitting storage.
Mike L.: also seeing increased eviction churn on per-shard metrics, probably due to new salting causing hotkey redistribution -> transient overload on some paging nodes.
SRE Bot: paging-node-07 mem pressure high, evictions/sec > 1200.
Amanda (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) Pause invalidation cron for new prefix namespace. 2) Route 100% traffic to prefix-hash v1 (rollback routing), 3) Temporarily increase prefetch workers on affected pool, 4) Warmup top prefixes. Who can run the toggle?
Kai W.: I can toggle routing. command: `infractl routing set-prefhash-variant --env prod --region us-west-2 --variant v1`
Mike L.: I'll patch autoscaler to add 3 more paging pods and increase prefetch parallelism: `kubectl scale deploy/paging-pool --replicas=12 -n prod-paging` and bump PREFETCH_WORKERS env var.
Jessica R.: warming script ready: `scripts/warmup_prefixes.py --top 10k --region us-west-2` will pre-populate cache for top keys. recommend running after routing flip.
Amanda (oncall): go for the routing flip first. Kai, please post when done.
Kai W.: running now. `infractl routing set-prefhash-variant --env prod --region us-west-2 --variant v1`
OpsBot: DeployBot: routing change applied by Kai W. at 2026-03-15T02:18:03Z. change-id=chg-5791-rollback-routing
Kai W.: confirmed: 100% -> v1. traffic observed moving, little drop on new-namespace hits.
Mike L.: scaling paging pool now. `kubectl scale` returned success. increasing prefetch workers.
SRE Bot: paging-pool replicas increased 9 -> 12. New pods joining ring.
Jessica R.: starting warmup now. stdout: `warmed 1023/10000 prefixes (10%)`
Amanda (oncall): pausing invalidation cron. Mike, can you double-check the cron history? we don't want it to continue.
Mike L.: `cronctl pause invalidator-prod-prefix-v2` done. last run was 02:17:12Z and we logged ~1.2M keys removed (that probably triggered a huge cache reset).
Jessica R.: after warmup ~p95 down to 420ms, p99 down to 980ms. still above normal but much better.
Customer Success: CS note: we have 14 tickets in last 20m, 3 flagged as high priority (latency causing timeouts). Logged customer-impact window 02:14:00 - 02:27:00.
Amanda (oncall): initial RCA hypothesis: prefix-hash v2 rollout changed key salting/scheme -> invalidator cron removed previous-prefixed keys -> mass misses -> paging/backfills -> eviction wave + hotshard overload -> p99 spikes and streaming stalls.
Kai W.: adding follow-ups: need a canary verification step for invalidation jobs and better warmup guard when changing key scheme. also add preflight to ensure hit-rate doesn't drop >20% after rollout.
Mike L.: immediate post-mitigation actions: 1) Keep v1 routing for 1h, 2) Re-run warmup for top 50k prefixes, 3) Re-enable invalidator only with dry-run and low-rate mode, 4) Run a targeted smoke test for streaming workloads.
Amanda (oncall): status update: incident degraded -> mitigated. p99 now 0.95s, p95 0.38s. streaming stalls returned to baseline. marking incident as mitigated. leaving follow-up tasks in INC-2026-0315-5791.
SRE Bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-5791 status: MITIGATED at 2026-03-15T02:31:18Z.
Customer Success: we've notified affected customers with ETA for full resolution and promised a follow-up postmortem.
Jessica R.: saving heap of logs and metrics to /artifacts/incidents/5791234567/. also capturing snapshot of prefixkey distribution for postmortem.
Amanda (oncall): handoff: Kai W. taking over for the next 60m to watch metrics and coordinate rollback-to-v2 plan only after automation and warmup are solved.
Kai W.: ack. I'll monitor p99/p95 and ensure invalidator is run in dry-run. will loop in product and infra for rollout gating.
Amanda (oncall): thanks team. I'll open the postmortem doc and assign owners. reactions: :thumbsup: :coffee: 
SRE Bot: Oncall handoff: Amanda -> Kai W. (duration 60m). recorded at 2026-03-15T02:33:00Z.
IncidentBot: Closing note: No data exfiltration, no 5xx spike beyond internal backfills. Next steps queued: rollout hardening, invalidator rate-limits, prewarm tooling.
